properties.what: Law 172/2023, in force 16 December 2023. Prohibits production and marketing of cell-cultured food, and bars meat words on plant-based products. The first national ban anywhere.
properties.caveat: Adopted before the EU scrutiny standstill period ended, which the European Commission has said makes its legal effect doubtful.

properties.what: A 2021 law bars cultivated meat from the canteens of schools, universities, hospitals and prisons. A wider ban was later introduced in Parliament.
properties.caveat: The wider bill has not passed.

properties.what: Parliament voted to prohibit the production and marketing of cultivated meat, the second clear national ban in Europe.
properties.caveat: The European Commission published a detailed opinion opposing it as unnecessary, since no cultivated product is authorised in the EU in any case.

properties.what: A prohibition modelled on Italy's was introduced in Parliament.
properties.caveat: Not passed as of this compilation.
